recorded: Every case passed against the original with GNU bash 3.2.57, curl 8.7.1, and jq 1.7.1, run as "bash conversa-longa.sh" from the scripts folder. The script and its requests are unit 5's, and the chat API answers them with the same fields the script reads from unit 5 to unit 9, so the thirty-turn run replays unit 5's recordings. The other answers were recorded from unit 6's chat server, whose answers unit 9 keeps for the routes they take, run from a copy whose model factory reads OPENAI_BASE_URL, with Ollama 0.40.11's gemma4:12b-mlx standing in for openai/gpt-4o-mini. With that stand-in, the twenty-fourth turn, a plan-and-execute run, outlasted the chat API's 180-second timeout, so that run replays the twenty-three answers and the timeout body the server sent. The failing case's second turn is a recorded one without promptTokens, as the chat API answers when the provider reports no usage, and its third turn replays the chat API's timeout body. The cases point BASE_URL to the replay, whose address changes on every run, so the header checks it by shape. Every other line follows from the replayed answers and is compared exactly, including the conversation id, promptTokens, and the token estimates, which count UTF-8 bytes and round down.
